name: Rabi'a al-Adawiyya
shortBio: Eighth-century Basran philosopher-mystic and founding architect of Sufi metaphysics of divine love (mahabba), redefining moral and religious action as disinterested devotion beyond fear of Hell or desire for Paradise.
centralQuestion: Can ethical and spiritual devotion be purified of instrumental fear and reward into unconditional love of the Divine for its own sake?

keyWorks.title: Discourses and Prayers on Disinterested Love (Mahabba)
keyWorks.description: Preserved sayings and mystical poetry transmitted through Attar and Al-Ghazali establishing pure disinterested divine love as foundational Sufi ethics.
